mapper.sql: SELECT c.id,c.case_no,c.customer_id,cu.customer_name,c.agent_id,a.agent_name,c.vehicle_id,c.frame_sn,c.product_model_id,m.model_name,c.motor_sn,c.battery_sn,c.display_sn,c.purchase_date,c.failure_time,c.fault_type,c.fault_part,c.error_code,c.description,c.attempted_repair,c.warranty_status,c.status,c.assignee_id,c.technical_judgment,c.solution,c.internal_note,c.rejection_reason,c.created_by,c.updated_by,c.submitted_at,c.closed_at,c.created_at,c.updated_at,cc.company_name,cc.contact_name,cc.contact_phone,cc.contact_email,cc.country_code,cc.region,cc.city,cc.address_line,cc.postal_code,cc.end_customer_purchase_date,cc.snapshot_source,cc.assignee_name FROM bike_after_sales_case c LEFT JOIN bike_after_sales_case_contact cc ON cc.case_id=c.id LEFT JOIN bike_customer cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=c.agent_id LEFT JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=c.product_model_id

where.if: AND (c.case_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.frame_sn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR cu.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_after_sales_case c LEFT JOIN bike_customer cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.id=#{id}

SELECT c.*,cc.company_name,cc.contact_name,cc.contact_phone,cc.contact_email,cc.country_code,cc.region,cc.city,cc.address_line,cc.postal_code,cc.end_customer_purchase_date,cc.snapshot_source,cc.assignee_name FROM bike_after_sales_case c LEFT JOIN bike_after_sales_case_contact cc ON cc.case_id=c.id WHERE c.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id,v.frame_sn,v.model_id,v.current_customer_id customer_id, CASE WHEN v.status=3 AND v.current_customer_id=o.customer_id THEN o.agent_id ELSE NULL END agent_id, (SELECT b.part_sn FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding b WHERE b.vehicle_id=v.id AND b.is_current=1 AND b.part_type='MOTOR' LIMIT 1) motor_sn, (SELECT b.part_sn FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding b WHERE b.vehicle_id=v.id AND b.is_current=1 AND b.part_type='BATTERY' LIMIT 1) battery_sn, (SELECT b.part_sn FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding b WHERE b.vehicle_id=v.id AND b.is_current=1 AND b.part_type='DISPLAY' LIMIT 1) display_sn FROM bike_vehicle v LEFT JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.order_no=v.current_order_no WHERE v.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_customer WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_agent WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_product_model WHERE id=#{id} AND enabled=1
mapper.sql: (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_agent_model_access a WHERE a.agent_id=#{agentId} AND a.model_id=m.id AND a.enabled=1) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.current_order_no=o.order_no WHERE o.agent_id=#{agentId} AND v.status=3 AND v.current_customer_id=o.customer_id AND v.model_id=m.id))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_product_model m WHERE m.id=#{id} AND m.enabled=1 AND
SELECT id,customer_name name FROM bike_customer WHERE status='ENABLED' ORDER BY customer_name,id
SELECT id,agent_name name FROM bike_agent WHERE status='ENABLED' ORDER BY agent_name,id
SELECT m.id,m.model_name name FROM bike_product_model m WHERE m.enabled=1 AND ORDER BY m.model_name,m.id
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_after_sales_case SET customer_id=#{request.customerId},vehicle_id=#{request.vehicleId},frame_sn=#{request.frameSn},product_model_id=#{request.productModelId},motor_sn=#{request.motorSn},battery_sn=#{request.batterySn},display_sn=#{request.displaySn},purchase_date=#{request.purchaseDate},failure_time=#{request.failureTime},fault_type=#{request.faultType},fault_part=#{request.faultPart},error_code=#{request.errorCode},description=#{request.description},attempted_repair=#{request.attemptedRepair},warranty_status=COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.warrantyStatus},''),warranty_status),updated_by=#{updatedBy} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT','NEEDS_INFO')

UPDATE bike_after_sales_case SET status=#{status},rejection_reason=#{reason},updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ,submitted_at=COALESCE(submitted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ,closed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ,solution=NULL,technical_judgment=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{fromStatus}

UPDATE bike_after_sales_case SET technical_judgment=#{request.technicalJudgment},solution=#{request.solution},internal_note=#{request.internalNote},updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UNDER_REVIEW'
mapper.select: SELECT id,case_id,author_id,visibility,body,created_at FROM bike_after_sales_message WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND visibility='CUSTOMER' ORDER BY created_at ASC,id ASC
SELECT id,case_id,author_id,visibility,body,created_at FROM bike_after_sales_message WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_after_sales_shipment(case_id,part_name,quantity,carrier,tracking_no,status,shipped_at,old_part_return_required,created_by) VALUES(#{caseId},#{request.partName},#{request.quantity},#{request.carrier},#{request.trackingNo},CASE WHEN #{request.trackingNo} IS NULL THEN 'PLANNED' ELSE 'SHIPPED' END,CASE WHEN #{request.trackingNo} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) END,#{request.oldPartReturnRequired},#{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id,case_id,part_name,quantity,carrier,tracking_no,status,shipped_at,old_part_return_required,old_part_return_received_at,created_by,created_at,updated_at FROM bike_after_sales_shipment WHERE case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY created_at ASC,id ASC

SELECT id,case_id,part_name,quantity,carrier,tracking_no,status,shipped_at,old_part_return_required,old_part_return_received_at,created_by,created_at,updated_at FROM bike_after_sales_shipment WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_after_sales_shipment WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND status='PLANNED'
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_after_sales_shipment SET carrier=#{request.carrier},tracking_no=#{request.trackingNo},status='SHIPPED',shipped_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND case_id=#{caseId} AND status='PLANNED'
mapper.select: SELECT id,action,operator_name,operation_time FROM bike_operation_log WHERE business_type='AFTER_SALES' AND business_id=CAST(#{caseId} AS CHAR) AND action NOT IN ('INTERNAL_MESSAGE_ADDED','INTERNAL_ATTACHMENTS_ADDED') ORDER BY operation_time ASC,id ASC
SELECT FROM bike_after_sales_attachment WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND visibility='CUSTOMER' ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT FROM bike_after_sales_attachment WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,case_id,message_id,object_key,file_name,content_type,file_size,sha256,visibility,category FROM bike_after_sales_attachment WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_after_sales_sales_agent scope WHERE scope.agent_id=c.agent_id AND scope.sales_user_id=#{userId} AND scope.enabled=1)

where.if: AND(c.case_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.frame_sn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR cu.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_after_sales_sales_agent WHERE sales_user_id=#{userId} AND agent_id=#{agentId} AND enabled=1
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_after_sales_case c LEFT JOIN bike_customer cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id
mapper.sql: a.id agent_id,a.agent_name company_name,CASE WHEN p.agent_id IS NULL THEN a.contact_name ELSE p.contact_name END contact_name,CASE WHEN p.agent_id IS NULL THEN a.contact_phone ELSE p.contact_phone END contact_phone,p.contact_email,p.country_code,p.region,p.city,p.address_line,p.postal_code,CASE WHEN p.agent_id IS NULL THEN 'MASTER' ELSE 'PROFILE' END source,p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bike_agent a LEFT JOIN bike_after_sales_company_profile p ON p.agent_id=a.id WHERE a.status='ENABLED' AND a.id=#{agentId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_after_sales_sales_agent scope WHERE scope.agent_id=a.id AND scope.sales_user_id=#{salesUserId} AND scope.enabled=1) ORDER BY a.agent_name,a.id
SELECT FROM bike_agent a LEFT JOIN bike_after_sales_company_profile p ON p.agent_id=a.id WHERE a.id=#{agentId} AND a.status='ENABLED'
SELECT id FROM bike_agent WHERE id=#{agentId} AND status='ENABLED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_after_sales_company_profile(agent_id,contact_name,contact_phone,contact_email,country_code,region,city,address_line,postal_code,updated_by) VALUES(#{agentId},#{contact.contactName},#{contact.contactPhone},#{contact.contactEmail},#{contact.countryCode},#{contact.region},#{contact.city},#{contact.addressLine},#{contact.postalCode},#{operatorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE contact_name=VALUES(contact_name),contact_phone=VALUES(contact_phone),contact_email=VALUES(contact_email),country_code=VALUES(country_code),region=VALUES(region),city=VALUES(city),address_line=VALUES(address_line),postal_code=VALUES(postal_code),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO bike_after_sales_case_contact(case_id,company_name,contact_name,contact_phone,contact_email,country_code,region,city,address_line,postal_code,end_customer_purchase_date,snapshot_source) SELECT c.id,COALESCE(a.agent_name,cu.customer_name), #{contact.contactName},#{contact.contactPhone},#{contact.contactEmail},#{contact.countryCode},#{contact.region},#{contact.city},#{contact.addressLine},#{contact.postalCode},#{endDate},'MANUAL' CASE WHEN p.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.contact_name ELSE COALESCE(a.contact_name,cu.contact_name) END,CASE WHEN p.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.contact_phone ELSE COALESCE(a.contact_phone,cu.contact_phone) END,p.contact_email,p.country_code,p.region,p.city,p.address_line,p.postal_code,#{endDate},CASE WHEN p.agent_id IS NULL THEN 'MASTER' ELSE 'PROFILE' END FROM bike_after_sales_case c LEFT JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=c.agent_id LEFT JOIN bike_customer cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_after_sales_company_profile p ON p.agent_id=c.agent_id WHERE c.id=#{caseId}
mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_sys_user_role rr JOIN bike_sys_role role_read ON role_read.id=rr.role_id WHERE rr.user_id=u.id AND role_read.enabled=1 AND (role_read.role_code='SUPER_ADMIN' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_sys_role_permission rrp JOIN bike_sys_permission pr ON pr.id=rrp.permission_id WHERE rrp.role_id=role_read.id AND pr.permission_code='AFTER_SALES_READ')))

AND u.enabled=1 AND u.user_type IN('WEB_ADMIN','WEB_OPERATOR') AND u.agent_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_sys_user_role bad JOIN bike_sys_role br ON br.id=bad.role_id WHERE bad.user_id=u.id AND br.enabled=1 AND br.role_code IN('WEB_AGENT','PDA_OPERATOR')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_sys_user_role ur JOIN bike_sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND r.enabled=1 AND(r.role_code='SUPER_ADMIN' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_sys_role_permission rp JOIN bike_sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id=r.id AND p.permission_code IN('AFTER_SALES_REVIEW','AFTER_SALES_TECH')('AFTER_SALES_READ'))))
mapper.select: SELECT u.id,CONCAT(u.display_name,' (',u.username,')') name FROM bike_sys_user u WHERE ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_sys_user u WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.enabled=1 AND u.user_type IN('WEB_ADMIN','WEB_OPERATOR') AND u.agent_id IS NULL AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_sys_user_role ur JOIN bike_sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND r.enabled=1 AND (r.role_code='SUPER_ADMIN' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_sys_role_permission rp JOIN bike_sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id=r.id AND p.permission_code='AFTER_SALES_SCOPE_ALL'))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_after_sales_sales_agent s WHERE s.sales_user_id=u.id AND s.agent_id=#{agentId} AND s.enabled=1))

SELECT u.id,CONCAT(u.display_name,' (',u.username,')') name FROM bike_after_sales_sales_agent s JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id=s.sales_user_id WHERE s.agent_id=#{agentId} AND s.enabled=1 ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id
SELECT id,username,display_name,enabled FROM bike_sys_user WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND user_type='AGENT' ORDER BY display_name,id
SELECT id,action,operator_name,operation_time FROM bike_operation_log WHERE business_type='AFTER_SALES_COMPANY' AND business_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS CHAR) ORDER BY operation_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_after_sales_sales_agent SET enabled=0,updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND enabled=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_after_sales_sales_agent(sales_user_id,agent_id,enabled,updated_by) VALUES(#{userId},#{agentId},1,#{operatorId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled=1,updated_by=VALUES(updated_by),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_after_sales_case SET assignee_id=#{assigneeId},updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{caseId} AND status NOT IN('CLOSED','REJECTED')
UPDATE bike_after_sales_case_contact SET assignee_name=#{name} WHERE case_id=#{caseId}
